en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a festive parade or demonstration passing through a town center. People wear traditional folk costumes and suits, one man carries a large banner with an illustration of women harvesting grain, and another person carries a large tricolor flag. Crowds line the street and look from balconies of multi‑story buildings with many shop signs in Cyrillic script. The general atmosphere suggests a civic or labor celebration.
